title: fix(rest)!: the approvals actions door answers 404 REQUEST_NOT_FOUND for an unknown or invisible request, as its parent door does
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D2T3MYD69CaE3sEdpqrhNgW)_

Fixes #27451
Fixes #27493

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill or doc teaches this door's answer for an unknown or invisible request id; `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx` names the `approvals.listActions(requestId)` call only

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`GET /api/v1/approvals/requests/:id/actions` 遇到不存在、或调用者无权看到的审批单,改为回 404 `REQUEST_NOT_FOUND`(与父接口 `GET …/requests/:id` 同一个查找、同一个响应体),不再回 200 空列表。
- 为什么改:「没有动作记录」与「没有这张审批单」以前无法区分;分诊裁定「404 `REQUEST_NOT_FOUND`, the same as the parent door.」。
- 风险与回滚:BREAKING(服务面收窄),只影响对不可读审批单读动作的调用方,SDK 的 `approvals.listActions` 会改为抛错;可见审批单的答复不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR 一个提交。
- 先看:`packages/rest/src/approvals-routes.ts`(`readableRequestOr404` 与 actions 处理器那一行),`packages/rest/src/rest-approvals-actions-unknown-request.test.ts`,`.changeset/27451-approvals-actions-unknown-request-404.md`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/rest-approvals-actions-unknown-request.test.ts`,预期 3 passed。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

**BREAKING** (a served-set narrowing of one REST door): reading the action trail of an approval request id that does not exist, or of a request the caller is not allowed to see, now answers `404 REQUEST_NOT_FOUND` instead of `200 {"data":[]}`. The changeset ships `patch` with the ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`: no metadata key changes, only the HTTP answer for a request the caller cannot read.

## What changes

| request | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/v1/approvals/requests/UNKNOWN/actions` | `200 {"data":[]}` | `404 {"code":"REQUEST_NOT_FOUND","error":"Approval request 'UNKNOWN' not found"}` |
| `GET …/requests/ID/actions`, ID exists but the caller cannot see it | `200 {"data":[]}` | the same `404` the parent door gives for ID |
| `GET …/requests/ID/actions`, ID visible to the caller | `200 {"data":[...]}` | unchanged |

The handler now resolves the parent request before listing. The lookup and the `404` envelope are the parent door's own: they move into one local helper, `readableRequestOr404`, inside `registerApprovalsEndpoints`, and both `GET …/requests/:id` and `GET …/requests/:id/actions` call it. There is no second copy of the rule. The parent door's answer is byte-for-byte what it was.

`IApprovalService.getRequest` answers `null` both for an id it does not hold and for a request outside the caller's visibility (`ApprovalService.loadRequest`, `enforceVisibility: true`). So the two cases still answer alike, and the door reveals nothing about which requests exist (the no-leak point of #27493).

Consumers: `ObjectStackClient.approvals.listActions` throws on any non-2xx answer, so it now rejects for such an id instead of resolving `[]`. In-repo UI callers: `RecordApprovalsPanel.tsx` already wraps each `listApprovalActions(id)` in `.catch(() => [])`; `approvalRequestsDataSource.ts`'s timeline read and `approvalsApi.ts` read the actions of a request they have already resolved. Each reads ids from the request list or the request read, which apply the same visibility rule.

## Tests

- New: `packages/rest/src/rest-approvals-actions-unknown-request.test.ts`, the real `RestServer` routes over an approvals stub that models the service's rule (`getRequest` is `null` for an unknown id and for a non-participant; `listActions` is gated by `getRequest`, as `ApprovalService` gates it).
  - Unknown id: actions `404`, `code: REQUEST_NOT_FOUND`, body deep-equal to the parent door's body, and `listActions` is never called.
  - Existing request, caller cannot see it: actions `404`, body deep-equal to the parent door's body for the same id. Same status and code as an unknown id, and the message differs only by the id it names. `listActions` is never called.
  - Visible request: `200 {"data": ROWS}` with the rows unchanged, and `listActions` called once with the id and the caller's context. The parent door still answers `200` with the row.

## Acceptance notes

- The fix adds one `getRequest` read before `listActions`, which runs its own `getRequest` as its tenant gate (`approval-service.ts`, `listActions`). That is two reads of the parent per actions request. The service's gate stays as defence in depth for non-REST callers. It is not removed here, because `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals` is outside this card's file surface.
- The parent door's handler changed only in shape: its lookup and `404` now come from the shared helper. That was needed to reuse the rule without copying it. Its answer is unchanged. No test drove the parent door's `GET` before, so the new file pins it too: its `404` (unknown and invisible) and its `200` row (visible).
